tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Turns a place and/or practice phrase into the keys every other tool takes. Example: "Harris County, TX truck accidents".

tools.name: supply_gap
tools.description: Ranks the states (state "US") or one state's counties by one demand count divided by one supply count. No composite score. Not legal advice.

tools.name: market_profile
tools.description: Every figure the linked open datasets hold for one state or county and one practice area. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: compare_markets
tools.description: The same practice-area figures for up to 10 states or counties side by side, plus per-100,000-resident rates where the legal-need dataset gives the population. Results are not legal advice.

tools.name: demand_trend
tools.description: The time series each linked demand dataset holds for a state or county. Not legal advice.

tools.name: rules_check
tools.description: The lawyer advertising rules (filing, required content, waiting periods, claims, referral, language, recording, texting, privacy). Results are not legal advice.
